title: Dark progenitors and massive descendants: A first ALMA perspective of radio-selected near-IR-dark galaxies in the COSMOS field
question: What are the spectroscopic redshifts, physical properties, molecular gas content and line kinematics of nine radio-selected NIR-dark galaxies in COSMOS, and could they be progenitors of massive passive z~3 galaxies?

data.sensitivity: Requested 0.32 mJy/beam per stacked channel; achieved median rms 0.2 mJy/beam, rising to 0.4 mJy/beam at higher frequency

recipe.method: Merge calibrated MSs in CASA; resample to ~0.02 GHz channels; first tclean with natural weighting to check rms
tclean mfs with natural weighting after masking lines; aperture photometry in CARTA on 2 sigma contour
key_parameters: aperture = 2 sigma contour of the continuum image
detection threshold S/N>3, 3 sigma upper limits otherwise

recipe.method: uvcontsub, 0th moment map, natural-weight cube, boxcar convolution, S/N cubes, S/N spectrum extraction with interferopy
key_parameters: boxcar widths 1-13 channels (60-780 km/s at 100 GHz)
rms from sigma clipping in the inner primary beam
extraction region = 2 sigma contour of the 0th moment map

recipe.method: Spurious probability following Jin et al. 2019 (N_Eff formula) and FINDCLUMPS positive/negative peak ratio
key_parameters: all lines S/N>6 have spurious probability < 1e-6 (Jin) and 100% reliability (Walter)
assumptions: Noise at phase centre approximately Gaussian (Jin method)

recipe.method: 0th moment maps of continuum-subtracted lines; CARTA aperture photometry on 2 sigma contour

Model the highest-S/N line as each CO transition for 0<z<8, test for second line, pick highest joint reliability; for single-line sources fix z at allowed values and choose lowest chi2 in CIGALE SED fit including the 3 mm continuum point
key_parameters: N_Eff for second line = number of CO transitions possible for the first line
joint spurious probability = product of first and second line probabilities

recipe.goal: Test line profiles for double-peaked structure
recipe.method: Fit single vs double Gaussian to the highest-S/N line and compare with partial F-test
key_parameters: significance threshold 0.05; 4 vs 7 free parameters (with residual continuum)

recipe.method: CIGALE with BC03 stellar populations, delayed-style exponentially declining SFH plus bursts, Charlot and Fall attenuation, Draine 2014 dust, Fritz 2006 torus, with redshift fixed to spec-z; SFR from L_IR (Kennicutt 2012)
key_parameters: AGN torus component added (Fritz et al. 2006)
median radio slope assumed for sources lacking a second radio detection (q_TIR)
assumptions: Chabrier IMF; flat LCDM with Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7, h=0.7

recipe.method: [CI](1-0) gas mass with the Papadopoulos et al. 2004 relation where [CI] detected; otherwise CO-based mass with alpha_CO and CO SLED rescaling to CO(1-0)
assumptions: CO SLED of Bothwell et al. 2013 DSFGs (no strong AGN)

recipe.method: tau_D = M(H2)/SFR; constant-SFR toy model evolving z and M* until gas exhausted, uncertainties by Monte Carlo; compared with massive passive z~3 galaxies of Schreiber et al. 2018
key_parameters: final state z_f = z_spec - Delta z, M*_f = M* + M(H2)

recipe.method: median |z_phot - z_spec|/(1+z_spec) for all nine spec-z

score_reason: Project code and most analysis steps (continuum, line search, reliability formulae, redshift logic, gas-mass equations, constants) are given with numeric tables, but imaging parameters, line masks, CIGALE grids and fit details are missing.
